policy: Only links verified against an exact event_id and public supporting evidence may appear below an event. A channel being online is not proof it is streaming that demonstration. A LIVE badge requires live_status=live and live_checked_at less than 15 minutes old. Recording links require recording_reviewed=true. No unverified autoplay/embeds.

fields.url: Public stream or channel URL on YouTube/Twitch/TikTok/Instagram
fields.reviewed: Must be true after source/date/location verified
fields.evidence_url: Public evidence showing connection with this specific demonstration
fields.valid_until: ISO time through which link may be displayed; can cover archival playback
fields.live_status: Optional 'live'; never set from a channel's general streaming status alone
fields.live_checked_at: ISO last verification time; LIVE expires after 15 minutes
fields.recording_reviewed: Must be true before showing the link as an archive
